title: Neked Kellene... – Aiming Advice At Someone

sections.title: From general advice to a specific person
sections.content: You already know kellene ("should, ought to") for general advice — Kellene sportolni ("One should exercise") — and the dative pronouns nekem/neked/neki/nekünk from kell. Put them together and advice gets a specific target: Neked kellene sportolni ("You should exercise") says it to one particular person, not just anyone.

items.english: He/she should go to the doctor.

sections.content: The infinitive after kellene stays exactly the same (pihenni, not a special "you"-form of it) — only the dative pronoun in front changes to say who the advice is for.
